title: M/s Om Sai Ram Rice Mill v. Chairman, Madhyanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
coram: Rajan Roy, J.; Saurabh Lavania, J.
disposition: Writ disposed of; billing dispute relegated to clause 6.5.
headnote: A writ court will not examine a billing dispute. The consumer may pursue an objection before the Executive Engineer under clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, to be decided within six weeks; off-season benefit may be sought thereafter in terms of the impugned order.
facts: M/s Om Sai Ram Rice Mill, through its proprietor, and another petitioner, consumers of Madhyanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd., challenged an order of the licensee. The mill faced electricity bills raised before April 2025 amounting to Rs. 12,39,271, which it disputed. The impugned order provided that off-season benefit for 1 April 2025 to 30 September 2025 would be available only if those bills were cleared and the dues paid. The mill sought writ interference with that condition.

holding_units.holding: A writ court will not examine a billing dispute. The consumer may avail the statutory remedy under clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005; any application filed or pending before the Executive Engineer shall be considered and decided as per law within six weeks. Once the billing dispute is resolved, the consumer may approach the authorities for off-season benefit in terms of the impugned order.

not_decided.point: Merits of the pre-April 2025 billing dispute of Rs. 12,39,271
not_decided.note: Relegated to clause 6.5 before the Executive Engineer; High Court declined to examine the bills.
